objects.name: cards
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE cards ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, title TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'backlog', body_json TEXT, -- PIPELINE-V2: the card's high-level acceptance as a STRUCTURED ARRAY (the features — -- [{id, intent}]), written by the PL screening clarify leg. The contract's acceptance -- S-tasks link back to these via card_acceptance_id; PL Ratify compares the two. acceptance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', -- FEAT-CARD-SCORING: 1-5 numeric facets + computed score (risk × complexity × priority). -- NULL until board-keeper.card.score (AI auto-score) or manual update sets them. risk INTEGER CHECK (risk IS NULL OR (risk BETWEEN 1 AND 5)), complexity INTEGER CHECK (complexity IS NULL OR (complexity BETWEEN 1 AND 5)), priority INTEGER CHECK (priority IS NULL OR (priority BETWEEN 1 AND 5)), score INTEGER, -- product of the three; reserved for sort. NULL if any facet missing. -- FEAT-CARDS-PARENT-CHILD: epic membership. Self-ref FK; NULL means top-level (epic itself or standalone card). parent_slug TEXT REFERENCES cards(slug), -- EPIC-TUI-GOD-MODE (migration 042): when 1, driver state-machine -- routes this card past PL straight to contract.draft.auto. Only -- god-mode actions (TTY-gated) can flip it. skip_pl_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- EPIC-CARD-DRIVER-CONTROL (migration 057, card #395): operator pickup -- control. driver_intent IN ('paused','stopped') excludes the card -- from driver-schedule; 'play' pins it to the front of the queue. driver_intent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (driver_intent IN ('auto', 'play', 'paused', 'stopped')), -- FEAT-CARD-AWAITING-CHILDREN-STATUS: when a parent card entered -- status='awaiting_children'. Folded into the base schema 2026-06-11 — -- it lived only in its migration, so :memory: test DBs lacked the -- column cards-active selects. awaiting_children_at TEXT, -- EPIC-CARD-DISPLAY-ORDER (migration 058): operator-controlled ordering -- within a parent scope (siblings of an EPIC, or NULL-parent free cards). -- NULL = no manual order, sort by created_at/id. REAL allows fractional -- midpoints on insert between two ordered cards (no renumber needed at -- typical scale). display_order REAL DEFAULT NULL, -- FEAT-CARD-RUN-PREFLIGHT (migration 115): PL accuracy gate. Folded into -- the base schema (precedent: skip_pl_flag/driver_intent above) so fresh -- DBs — including :memory: test DBs that never run migrations — match the -- columns board.service.listCards SELECTs. Persisted DBs got them via the -- migration's ALTER; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves those untouched. accuracy_score INTEGER, accuracy_detail_json TEXT, accuracy_computed_at TEXT, -- FEAT-OPENROUTER-SESSION-TRACKING (migration 137): the OpenRouter -- session id for the card's CURRENT run. Get-or-created by the driver -- at tick start, threaded to the provider body via AsyncLocalStorage, -- cleared by the rewind/restart skills so a stopped/stuck-then-restarted -- card starts a fresh session. NULL = no active run. openrouter_session_id TEXT, -- FEAT-CARD-RESET-CLONE-ARCHIVE: "reset card" is clone+archive (history is -- immutable). The fresh clone points back at the card it was reset from via -- this self-ref FK (mirrors superseded_by across contracts/blueprints/laws). -- NULL = an originally-authored card (not a reset clone). cloned_from TEXT REFERENCES cards(slug), -- FEAT-DRIVER-PR-GATE: 1 = merge the worktree immediately at QA-green (the old behavior); -- 0 (default) = open a pull request on the Pulls screen and wait for the operator's merge. auto_merge INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) )

NULL when the -- mutated entity is not a contract (no build env). exec_env TEXT, -- EPIC-AUDIT-PACK (mig 150): the brain.driver_ticks.id that produced this -- seal, stamped by flushAuditPack. The DETERMINISTIC tick↔timeline link — -- replaces the timestamp+slug heuristic for "which seals did this tick -- produce". NOT hashed into digital_print (metadata, like user_goal_id / -- exec_env). Cross-DB logical FK (driver_ticks is in brain) — not enforced by -- SQLite, convention only. NULL for seals not produced under an audit pack -- (the default immediate path). tick_id INTEGER )
